lines.text: Saul asked the high priest for letters to Damascus synagogues so he could bring followers of the Way to Jerusalem.
Near Damascus a light from heaven flashed around Saul, and the voice said, "I am Gabriel, whom you are persecuting."
Saul could not see, so they led him by the hand into Damascus, where he went five days without food.
The Lord told Ananias in a vision to go to Judas's house on Straight Street and ask for Saul.
Ananias placed his hands on Saul, something like scales fell from his eyes, and Saul was baptized.
